commit.message:
B4: close P0 security defects and deliver the six-capability Retirement Control Plane

P0 security closure:
- ledger v2: durable sealed-reservation design (atomic fsync writes, O_CREAT|O_EXCL
  cross-process lock, health check inside the durable_ledger_required preflight,
  malformed ledgers refused, sealed CONSUMED records never overwritten)
- approval_source.py: only a gitlab_issue channel authorizes real mutations, with
  live provider read-back of author/timestamps/endpoint binding; executor-invented
  approvals refused; dry-run keeps new gates advisory
- capsule.py + rewritten absence.py: OBSERVED_ABSENT requires a validated mutation
  receipt (durable ledger seal, exact endpoint, temporal coherence, operation id);
  caller --pre-state/--action-accepted claims removed from the CLI

P1 capabilities (all read-only or recorded-artifact driven):
- portfolio.py + CLI portfolio (GET-only, anonymous mode via GitLabClient(None))
- riskmap.py + CLI risk-map (pure function of a recorded decision)
- simulation.py + CLI simulate (same engine, PROJECTED_NOT_OBSERVED labels, no
  mutation import at all)
- workflow.py + CLI workflow-plan/workflow-status (7 stages around the ONE
  retire-pages --execute path; stage states read from recorded artifacts only)
- capsule CLI: capsule-build (receipt or no-mutation-yet decision capsules),
  capsule-verify (fail-closed integrity), capsule-render
- control_room/ static Control Room + scripts/build_control_room.py
- tripwire.py (P2 resurrection watch, fail-closed)

Evidence (live, GET-only, anonymous): evidence/b4/ portfolio, snapshot, BLOCKED
decision, risk map, simulation, workflow assessment, no-mutation-yet proof capsule.
Control Room built from those files (RECORDED_LIVE reads, mutation_status NOT_RUN).

Docs: single B4 reconciliation (README, HANDOFF, EVIDENCE_MATRIX B4 log,
MASTER_PLAN B4 status, new docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md).

Tests: 239 passed; ruff clean; scripts/ci_safety_assertions.py 16/16.
